memory_id.description: Exact memory id to update. Search memory first if unknown.

content.description: Replacement memory content. Use an empty string to keep existing content.

kind.description: Replacement short category. Use an empty string to keep existing kind.

tags_mode.description: Use keep to preserve existing tags. Use replace to replace tags with the tags array.

tags.description: Replacement tags when tags_mode is replace. Use an empty array to clear tags.

confidence_mode.description: Use keep to preserve confidence. Use set to apply the confidence value.

confidence.description: Replacement confidence when confidence_mode is set.

pinned_mode.description: Use keep to preserve pinned. Use set to apply the pinned value.

pinned.description: Replacement pinned value when pinned_mode is set.

reason.description: Why this memory is being updated.
